EYEOTA Keyboard — Type. Fold. Play.

WORK IN PROGRESS — KEYBOARD TO GAMING CONTROLLER. Two circular keyboard halves fold together with the keys facing inward, forming a circular gaming controller. Turn the folded device over to access its upright gaming controls. Two 100-facet dice-shaped controls replace traditional thumbsticks, tilting slightly in different directions and returning to center to illustrate analog joystick input. This concept is continuing to be developed; comfort, electronics, hinge clearances and durability require physical prototyping.

EYEOTA Desktop

Your typing appears as notes. Click Read my typing to see the original text. No copying between boxes is needed.

Verified access: lock or reopen a saved message

To protect your typing: enter a password, click Lock my message, then save it. To reopen it: load the saved file or paste its locked notes, enter the same password, then click Unlock saved message.

Live typing notes disguise text. Lock my message encrypts it with your password and clears the draft. Locking and unlocking send your message and password to your EYEOTA server over HTTPS. These routes do not save them. Save your locked message before closing. There is no password recovery. Prototype: use test messages until reviewed.

How this file format works

Dictionary v1 stays on this site and is not included in your downloaded file. Dictionary-based files need a compatible EYEOTA decoder. This version compares site dictionary references, compressed references, Brotli, gzip, deflate, raw deflate, and uncompressed text, stores the smallest supported result with a verification header. Earlier sound files can still be opened. Next experiments: repeated phrase dictionaries and adaptive settings. Each version must recover the data exactly before its storage results count.

EYEOTA OWN CODEC v1 ready. Click ENCODE to create a new compact file. Maximum 20,000 UTF-8 bytes.
